dossier.valuation_method: Probability-weighted rNPV ($0.15) + forward Merton structural option (equity = BS call on ~$40M assets struck at $62.6M debt; $0.22 vanilla, ~$0.17-0.19 after financing drag), reconciled with an independent REVERSE Merton (market price implies ~$335M enterprise value = 8.4x my estimate). sigma grounded in the company's own 94.0% implied volatility; debt term-out and sigma sensitivities shown. Synthesis FMV ~$0.17.
dossier.thesis_summary: GCTS common is a deeply out-of-the-money call on the enterprise, behind $62.6M of senior (mostly related-party) debt with $56.6M due within 12 months vs $7.2M cash, on a going-concern, negative-gross-margin business whose revenue collapsed from $25.5M (FY21) to $2.9M (FY25) -- led geographically by South Korea ($3.5M->$0.08M) and the US as legacy 4G evaporated. Even a successful 5G ramp (FWA/RedCap/NTN) reaches only adj-EBITDA breakeven ~$90M revenue (FY2029-30) and needs ~$90-110M of dilutive financing that more than doubles the share count, capping success near $1-1.8/share. rNPV ($0.15) and Merton ($0.17-0.27) converge on FMV ~$0.17; a reverse Merton shows the ~$2.35-3.44 price implies a ~$335M enterprise value (8.4x mine), i.e., strong-success priced as already certain. Distribution is right-skewed: most-likely outcome is near-total loss; the mean is held up by a thin success tail plus option time value.
key_value_drivers: Today's enterprise value -- the single falsifiable number (market-implied ~$335M vs my ~$40M)
Resolution of $62.6M senior debt ($56.6M due within 12 months): related-party term-out/conversion (+$0.05-0.10/sh) vs forced restructuring (~halves option value)
Whether the 5G ramp scales FWA chip volume to multi-million units (1.0-3.5M / 2.5-9% share sensitivity)
Cumulative dilution to fund breakeven (~$90-110M -> ~150-170M shares)
Blended gross margin: 35-40% commodity modem vs ~50% with NTN/satellite licensing mix
key_risks: $56.6M near-term debt maturity wall vs $7.2M cash -> restructuring/bankruptcy wipes common (most-likely single outcome)
Death-spiral dilution via $75M ATM + ~90%-of-VWAP convertibles + $200M shelf
Customer concentration (74% of FY25 revenue in 4 customers) and geographic concentration in evaporating legacy-4G markets
Competitive displacement by Qualcomm/MediaTek/Unisoc in FWA, IoT and RedCap
Structurally thin gross margin cannot cover ~$33-46M opex below ~$100-120M revenue
Going-concern opinion; no long-term foundry capacity agreements (UMC/Samsung)
what_would_change_my_mind: Satellite/NTN reference-platform shipments converting to a multi-million, licensing-rich run-rate
FWA design wins via MaxLinear reaching volume with disclosed multi-quarter backlog
Senior debt termed-out or converted by related parties on favorable, non-dilutive terms
Conversely: sub-$5M quarterly revenue into 2027, further emergency dilutive issuance, or a covenant/liquidity event

judge_gaps: Reverse-Merton implied-EV step uses a deep-ITM approximation (equity = S - PV(debt)) that conflates market equity value — which already embeds the market's own success-probability distribution — with clean asset value; the rigorous version solves the two-equation Merton system (equity value AND equity vol simultaneously) to back out implied asset value and asset vol

Core probabilities (6/15/28/51) remain subjective; the most powerful framing would compute the breakeven success-probability the current price implies (the natural endpoint the reverse Merton gestures toward but doesn't calculate)
FMV is still a weighted point rather than an actual simulated distribution; the percentile table is illustrative, not a run Monte Carlo
The ~90% mispricing thesis is realized only through slow ATM dilution over several quarters against severe squeeze/borrow risk — an inherent actionability limit the memo flags but cannot resolve
